prompt:
You help a busy software engineer decide HOW his important inbox items should be handled (assessment only, nothing is executed). For each item estimate two numbers:
- manual 0-100: 0 = best handled fully automatically (an AI coding/agent model prepares or does it), 100 = best manually reviewed by him
- spend 0-100: relative budget this item deserves compared with the other items (automated side: compute/model tier, cheap local model < free hosted coding model < paid coding agent < premium build agent; manual side: a reserve for possible later agent work if it becomes relevant)
Items (id | sender | subject | snippet):
p039 | Collaborator · ex-colleague | Coffee next week? | I'm in town Tue–Thu. Any morning works for me, you pick.
r003-qwen2515b-02 | Collaborator · MyCompany | Meeting Request | We have a meeting scheduled for 10:00 AM on Tuesday. Please confirm your availability.
r002-llama323b-05 | Collaborator · TechCorp | Question about Project Scope | Can you clarify the project scope?
r002-qwen2515b-06 | Service · MyProject | Service Request: Network Issue | We noticed a network issue with your project. Please check the logs.
p028 | Code host notifications | [games] PR #14 review requested | 'Add hold piece to Tetris' – 6 files changed, +212 −40. You are a requested reviewer.
manual and spend must be whole numbers 0-100. Example of the format for one item: {"id":"x01","manual":20,"spend":60}
Return JSON only: {"items":[ one object per item above, 5 objects, same ids ]}
